conditions.detail: Two-node DGX Spark cluster launched torchrun-style by the dspark runtime: --nnodes 2, this box is rank 0 and master (--node-rank 0 --master-addr 10.100.40.1, a 200G QSFP port), the second rank is the peer Spark over the same fabric; no ray this time - --distributed-executor-backend mp with one VLLM::Worker_TP per node. Head node also hosts an idle GNOME session, earlyoom, and the open-webui + searxng CPU-only containers; the server binds 0.0.0.0:8888 (LAN-reachable, unlike the earlier 127.0.0.1 serves) because open-webui fronts it. Ambient at start: GPU idle, 48C, 11W.
conditions.isolation_check: Measured, not asserted: nvidia-smi compute apps on the head node at run start = exactly one process (VLLM::Worker_TP0, 106,533 MiB); open-webui and searxng hold no GPU allocation and the cluster has no other GPU work (torch.distributed master saw exactly 2 ranks). Server socket 0.0.0.0:8888 is reachable from the LAN; no concurrent client requests were observed during the run window (connection sampling showed only the harness).

gotchas.text: The driver reported thermal/hardware slowdown during the run — the numbers are throttled.
No engine version file for vllm@0.21.1rc1.dev339+g1967a5627bc3; no defaults could be dropped from the canonical config.

TP=2 spans two GB10 nodes over the 200G QSFP fabric, torch.distributed-style (--nnodes 2, master 10.100.40.1), not ray: per-layer all-reduce crosses one RDMA link exactly once (2 ranks), the cheapest cross-node topology possible short of single-node. Compare against hardware.count=2 cells; the Qwen3.8 arms on this hardware measure different models and topologies.

The engine is a fork build whose version string (0.21.1rc1.dev339+g1967a5627bc3) names an upstream commit, not the fork patches: engine.build is pinned to the container image digest sha256:fe230273... for exactly the reason the validator demands (engines/sparkinfer/960652b is a different, earlier build of the same lineage - MiaAI-Lab repo vs this image's org.bjk110.dspark labels - so recording this run under sparkinfer would have claimed the wrong build).

The checkpoint declares DeepseekV4ForCausalLM in config.json but the runtime serves DeepseekV4VForConditionalGeneration via --hf-overrides - that swap is what enables the vision tower that IS present in the shards (0.41B tensors). Any reproduction must pass the same override or the model loads as text-only.

Speculation is dspark (SparkInfer), num_speculative_tokens=5 with probabilistic draft sampling - a draft architecture the checkpoint itself carries (dspark_block_size, dspark_markov_rank, dspark_target_layer_ids in config.json, 3 nextn layers in the shards). Not comparable to the MTP-3/MTP-4 arms on this hardware, and the plausibility bound correctly gives it no credit.

KV cache runs at nvfp4_ds_mla with block-size 256 (--kv-cache-dtype) - KV is 4-bit while weights are MXFP4-experts+FP8; max-model-len is 1,048,576 (yarn-factor-16 rope), the largest context served on this hardware so far in the atlas.

thinking is disabled at the template level (--default-chat-template-kwargs {thinking: false}) - opposite default to the Qwen3.8 arms, where reasoning consumed most of the 256-token budget. Output-token figures here are all answer tokens, so per-token rates are not comparable to those cells either.
Telemetry (gpu_util/power/temp) samples the head node (rank 0) only; the peer rank's sensors are not captured.

provenance.notes: First measurement of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp anywhere in the atlas and first cell for the model: served from the official repo snapshot 86f746b3 (native mixed quant - 296.35B MXFP4 expert values + fp8 block-quant remainder, 167.8 GB), sharded TP=2 across two DGX Sparks. Model and quant registry entries added in this PR from the shard headers. Engine is a vLLM fork build (0.21.1rc1.dev339+g1967a5627bc3) inside vllm-dspark-runtime:dspark-nvfp4-stage-c - SparkInfer dspark lineage (image labels org.bjk110.dspark.runtime); the sparkinfer engine entry belongs to a different build of that lineage, so this run is recorded under vllm with engine.build pinned to the image digest. Draft is dspark num_speculative_tokens=5 probabilistic sampling, with the draft architecture shipped inside the checkpoint itself (dspark_* config fields + 3 nextn layers). KV cache quantized to nvfp4_ds_mla at block-size 256; async-scheduling on; flashinfer-autotune ON (both earlier GB10 arms disabled it). thinking is disabled via --default-chat-template-kwargs {thinking: false}, so this workload measures bare chat answers, not reasoning traces. Server was already running (attach mode); harness only measured.
